why_ai: Software vendor with no licence; AI-native platforms can rebuild analytics and reporting cheaply.
why_clarity: Data pipelines are codified but whether an input caused yield is confounded and known yearly.
why_digital: Machine and field data processed on screens, often sold through dealers and co-ops.

why_ai: Agronomist advice rides on field visits and grower relationships, though scouting and reports automate.
why_clarity: Advice quality varies by agronomist and is judged on season-end yield.
why_digital: Starts from field scouting, ends as tablet reports, sold through local retailers and consultants.

why_ai: Piece-rate payroll and compliance records are mechanical software functions with modest regulatory accountability.
why_clarity: Piece counts, hours and pay are exact and checkable against wage rules.
why_digital: Inputs begin as paper tickets and field counts; output is digital pay and compliance records.

why_ai: Position aggregation and scenario analysis are computable software that AI-native tools can replicate.
why_clarity: Bushels priced, basis and storage cost are exact numbers in a standard calculation.
why_digital: Contracts, prices and positions are data, delivered as a dashboard to growers remotely.

why_ai: Scouting capture and report generation software is the cost structure and is directly automatable.
why_clarity: Field-to-report workflow repeats per acre with a measurable hours-per-report target.
why_digital: Starts from in-field scouting notes and photos; output is a digital report to growers.

why_ai: Schema and entity reconciliation against published standards is exactly what AI automates well.
why_clarity: A reconciled field record either matches across brands or it does not.
why_digital: Machine data files in, reconciled data out, sold platform to platform.

why_ai: Prescription credibility depends on co-op relationships and outcome evidence, not just generated recommendations.
why_clarity: Prescriptions recur every season but proving they paid needs yield results months later.
why_digital: Prescription files and records are digital, sold through local co-op and retailer relationships.

why_ai: Causal on-farm effect estimation is hard and high-stakes, though delivered entirely by software.
why_clarity: Yield effects are confounded by weather and only observed once per season.
why_digital: Instrumented machine data analysed on screen, sold to growers often via equipment dealers.

why_ai: Recordkeeping and compliance software for small farms is generic admin AI can absorb.
why_clarity: Records and compliance forms are defined, but forty crops and channels add variation.
why_digital: Records originate outdoors and on paper; product is online software bought directly.

why_ai: Block-level costing and harvest planning software has no licence or relationship moat.
why_clarity: Per-block costs are checkable, but each orchard and crop differs in structure.
why_digital: Inputs come from blocks, trees and harvest crews; output is digital planning and costing.

why_ai: Report generation from a common record is solved software; third-party verification adds some accountability.
why_clarity: Programme protocols define the evidence required, repeated across growers and programmes.
why_digital: Farm records in, programme reports out, transacted with buyers and administrators remotely.
